Welcome to our unique paradise
Why visit Swell Eco Lodge?
Swell Eco Lodge South Africa offers catered or self-catered accommodation in a remote location in the Transkei Wild Coast, ideal for couples, groups and families.
​
Set within the rolling hills of Mngcibe, we invite you to enjoy pure relaxation and fun while supporting a green way of life.
​
Spectacular sea views, jumping whales, roaming cattle and a view of rural life in this wonderful village is only a part of your holiday experience!
​
Our lodge is made up of traditional Rondavel structures which blend into its beautiful surroundings and our interiors are modern, calming and artistic.
​
Join us now for a South African holiday with a personal touch you will never forget!

Airbnb
"The Swell Eco Lodge is furnished with such a wonderful taste and it is equipped very well. The view from our deck was breathtaking. Unfortunately we had just 2 nights. We would recommend at least a 3 night stay, because the area offers a lot of walks and activities. The staff was extraordinary friendly and helpful. And a last thing to mention is, that you can order fresh bread and pizza. Both were very nice. Thank you for an unforgettable experience."
Anne-Madeleine, Denmark

Wow, what a place! Fantastic accomodation at an even more fantastic spot! Lovely staff and absolutely stunning nature.
Lexi, South Africa
Airbnb
We absolutely love it here at Swell and honestly think this by far the best place to stay in Mdumbi. It's literally 5 minutes from the beach, quiet, beautiful, and the rondawels are so well built and decorated. Loved every minute and we can't wait to go back!
Jaco, South Africa
Airbnb
Wow, this was simply spectacular in every aspect. Beautiful accomodation and surroundings. Super friendly and helpful staff. This was my 3rd time to visit the Mdumbi, and 1st time Swell Eco Lodge, and I will be back for sure!
